summary: The step pictures are the main problem: a tiled kaleidoscope pattern and ghosts of the canopy, rays, firs, floor and fallen leaves show from step 1, and steps 8 and 9 lay flat hard-edged slabs and rectangular blocks that stay on the canvas until the last step, which then jumps to finished foliage. Several shapes are lumpy or misplaced (path blobs, far-trunk feet, rock shade on the wrong side), and the words carry a few small contradictions (sun position, trunk feet, angle-brush text on flat-brush steps).
